info.description:
Every /v1 route outside /public needs an access token. The active
branch is not a token claim: it travels in the X-Branch-Id header
and is validated per request.
info.title: Coti API

get.description:
Reports that the process is up. Checks no dependency, so a failing
database does not get the container restarted.

Reports whether the process can serve traffic, which means both database
pools answer.

post.description:
Advances the session epoch, which invalidates every outstanding access
token for the user, and revokes the presented refresh family. The body is
optional: a client that lost its refresh token must still be able to end
the session.

get.description:
Returns one page of the account's catalog, ordered by name. Soft-deleted
items are hidden unless include_inactive is set.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on canonical name or code
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Page size; defaults to CATALOG_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE and is capped at CATALOG_MAX_PAGE_SIZE
parameters.name: limit

post.description:
Creates an account-level catalog item. Availability, stock, and price are
set per branch by their own endpoints.

409.description: The account already has a product with that code

put.description:
Replaces the editable attributes: an omitted nullable field clears the
column. is_active is the exception — omitted leaves it untouched.

parameters.description: Product as it should end up
parameters.name: body

409.description: The account already has a product with that code

delete.description:
Soft delete: the row survives because quote and price history point at
it. Repeating the call is harmless.

get.description:
direction picks which end of the relation to read: OUTGOING is what can
be offered instead of this product, INCOMING is what this product stands
in for. Defaults to OUTGOING.

post.description:
The product in the path is the base. type says what the alternative is
relative to it: EQUIVALENT, PREMIUM, or ECONOMY.

404.description: Either product is unknown to the account

422.description: A product cannot be its own alternative

delete.description: The link is addressable from either of the two products it joins.

get.description:
Returns the active branch's row when the request carries X-Branch-Id, and
every branch of the account when it does not.

parameters.description: Active branch; omit to read every branch
parameters.name: X-Branch-Id

put.description:
Creates the branch's row or updates it. Deactivating is how a branch stops
offering an item the account still catalogs.

422.description: No active branch, or a stock NUMERIC(14,2) cannot hold

get.description:
Every validity period, newest first, open and closed. Scoped to the active
branch when the request carries X-Branch-Id, account-wide otherwise.

parameters.description: Active branch; omit to read every branch
parameters.name: X-Branch-Id

post.description:
Opens a new validity period and closes the previous one at the same
instant. Nothing is overwritten, so the history of what was quoted when
survives. min_price is the floor the discount engine may not cross, so it
cannot exceed price.

422.description: No active branch, min_price above price, or valid_from before the current period

get.description: Trade vocabulary that improves lexical catalog matching.

post.description:
source records where the term came from: MANUAL for one a person loaded,
LEARNED for one the matching pipeline proposed. Defaults to MANUAL.

409.description: The product already carries that term

post.description:
Exchanges credentials for an access token and a refresh token. A bad
email, a bad password, and a disabled user all answer 401 alike, on
purpose. The refresh token is shown exactly once — only its hash is kept.

Consumes the presented refresh token and mints its successor in the same
family. Replaying a consumed token inside the grace window is treated as
a benign race; past it, the whole family is revoked as theft.

stock.description: decimal string; null when the branch does not track it.

detail.description: set when a body failed binding or validation.
